prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Learn how to move, summon, and interact with your new pet anytime right from your desktop menu.", "Quick Controls Overview"]
1: ["Desktop Shortcuts & Controls", "Right-click your pet on the desktop to talk, hide, or adjust pet settings anytime.", "Got It!"]
2: ["Save Your New Friend", "Sign in to keep your pet safely synced across all your desktop devices."]
3: ["Verify Pet Appearance", "Review your pet sprite preview and settings before finalizing adoption.", "Looks Great!"]
4: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "Building your custom pet graphics and desktop animations..."]
5: ["Select standard companion or custom creation. You can always change pets later in settings."]
6: ["Secure Your Pet Cloud Backup", "Sign in to ensure your pet attributes, custom memories, and settings are never lost.", "Backup & Continue"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Welcome your official desktop pet into its new home!"]
8: ["We will send a desktop popup as soon as your pet is ready to roam."]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Bring an interactive pet to your desktop in under two minutes.", "Start Choice"]
